description: This file defines the MessageOnlyLogFilter class, a filter implementation for logging that only outputs messages, suitable for simplified on-screen logs. It implements the LogNode interface and can chain to other LogNodes.

classes.name: MessageOnlyLogFilter
classes.description: A log filter class that outputs only the message part of logs and filters out other metadata, facilitating more readable log output.

methods.name: MessageOnlyLogFilter
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the filter with an optional next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Processes a log entry, forwarding only the message to the next node if available.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.
